answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a formidable Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment. To reach the summit of network influence, an attacker must acquire significant assets, a cost analogous to the scarcity of saffron, ensuring that creating infinite identities remains prohibitively expensive. If an agent attempts to whisper false data into the consensus layer, the protocol slashes their stake, imposing a direct economic loss that deters malicious identity proliferation.
